notes:
Inbound SMB lead - small CS-focused startup building a chat support assistant + internal doc search. Mostly public cloud, came through self-serve signup.

Key pain: data privacy & retention. Repeated Qs from founder/tech lead: 
- 'How long do you keep logs and prompts? Can we opt users out or request deletion?'
- 'Are prompts or any customer content used to train public models?'
- 'We need a DPA and an ability to purge specific user conversations via API.'

Current posture: evaluating hosted API but very sensitive to default retention. Wants short log retention by default (7-30 days), configurable retention windows, and a deletion endpoint. Also asks for audit logs and ability to redact PII on ingest.

Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, expects low monthly spend (1k-10k ARR) initially; will scale if cost/perf looks good.

Quotes/notes from call: 'We can't send full transcripts to third parties; need strong guarantees.' Founder asked about region of storage (prefer US-only) and whether prompts are stored unencrypted.

Action items: provide privacy/retention FAQ, DPA + sample deletion API docs, confirm default retention policy for hosted_api, confirm whether data used for training (explicit NO unless customer opts in), confirm region of storage and encryption at rest. SE to demo retention controls on 2026-03-10.
